summary:
亞馬遜最新季度每股盈餘大幅超越市場預期，展現強勁的獲利成長動能。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達到5.75美元，遠超預期的1.83美元。
• 本季獲利能力顯著提升，展現成本控制與營運效率的優化成果。
• 本益比維持在20.72倍的相對合理水準。
ai_view:
觀點：本季獲利大幅超預期發出強烈的正面訊號，突顯公司成本優化見效。短中期內有助於支撐股價表現並提升市場信心。後續應持續追蹤營收成長動能、AWS雲端業務表現以及營業利益率的變化。

需留意：宏觀經濟不確定性可能對消費者支出造成潛在壓力。；雲端運算與電商市場的競爭日益激烈。

summary_en:
Amazon reported significantly higher-than-expected EPS, demonstrating robust earnings growth momentum.
• EPS reached $5.75, substantially beating the consensus estimate of $1.83.
• Profitability significantly improved, reflecting optimized cost control and operational efficiency.
• Trailing P/E ratio remains at a relatively reasonable level of 20.72.

View: The significant EPS beat sends a strong positive signal, highlighting the success of cost optimization efforts. In the near to medium term, this should support stock performance and boost market confidence. Future tracking should focus on revenue growth momentum, AWS cloud performance, and operating margin trends.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainties could pose potential pressure on consumer spending.; Increasing competition in the cloud computing and e-commerce markets.
